visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a human arm. A digital filter overlays a pair of human eyes and a mouth directly onto the skin. The skin appears dry. The mouth moves as if speaking. The background is a plain, neutral-colored wall with soft lighting. (2) A young man wearing round glasses and a light blue t-shirt appears in a brightly lit indoor setting. He holds a white ceramic cup and pours clear water onto his left forearm. Behind him, beige curtains and a ceiling with recessed lighting are visible. (3) The shot returns to the close-up of the arm with the filtered face. Clear water droplets are now visible on the skin. The eyes blink and the mouth moves expressively. (4) The man is shown again, gesturing with his hands and looking toward the camera with a puzzled expression. (5) A close-up of the man's face shows him looking directly into the lens. A text variety overlay appears near his head. (6) A hand holds a white pump bottle of CeraVe Moisturising Lotion in an indoor living room with a dark grey couch. (7) A fast-paced montage displays white lotion being dispensed and spread across the skin of a forearm. Blue graphical icons representing molecular structures appear as overlays. (8) The man touches his forearm, smiling and nodding with a satisfied expression. (9) A white tub of CeraVe Moisturising Cream is presented on a black table. A small amount of white cream is applied to an elbow and rubbed in. (10) The man tests the skin's non-greasy texture by pressing his palm against his arm. (11) The final shot returns to the arm with the filtered face, which now appears smooth and well-moisturized, with the mouth smiling broadly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, filtered male voice speaks with exaggerated dramatic emotion against a silent background. The speech is clear and rapid. (2) A splash sound effect of liquid hitting skin occurs, followed by a loud, high-arousal yell from the filtered voice. (3) A natural mid-pitched male voice enters, speaking calmly and reasonably. (4) Harsh scratching and friction sound effects accompany the filtered voice yelling in pain. (5) A fast-paced electronic drum beat at 124 BPM begins. The high-pitched filtered voice shifts into a rhythmic, fast-paced narration style. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect plays. The music adds synthesizer layers and becomes more vibrant. (7) A series of 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are synchronized with specific emphasized words in the narration. (8) The natural male voice speaks with a rising, surprised intonation. The upbeat BGM continues at a steady volume. (9) A delicate 'sparkle' sound effect plays during a demonstration of skin smoothness. (10) The high-pitched voice delivers the final tagline with a wide, ascending pitch contour, ending on a sustained high note as the BGM hits a final percussive beat and fades.
